description: Full verification table: daily MAE/bias per station, lead, method, version. The audit table behind our free verification summary: every scored forecast/actual pair, aggregated at daily granularity per station × lead × method segment × model version, over a selectable window up to 90 days. Each cell carries our MAE, signed bias, the raw-NWS baseline MAE on the same rows where our forecast can differ from NWS, and sample counts. Scored against real NWS station observations; versions are never mixed. [HTTP: GET /v1/verification/table · price $0.03 via x402 · docs https://x402-factory.com/docs/weather.verification-table]
